title: Islands of Theorem
mathematical_role: Display the logical status boundary between established partial terrain and the still-open universal one-half conjecture.
learning_objective: Distinguish elementary results, bounded exact verification, imported dimension-free positive bounds, and formal/structural results from the unresolved universal half-frequency statement.
literal_semantics: The universal one-half statement is labeled open.
Exact bounded verification is labeled finite and not an unbounded proof.
Imported dimension-free positive bounds are labeled source-specific in constants and hypotheses.
Formal and structural results are presented as separately scoped records rather than as the universal theorem.
nonliteral_semantics: Box height is a pedagogical staging device and does not provide a quantitative measure of theorem strength or historical priority.

notes: Exact finite-example data are reproduced by tests/test_visual_pedagogy_batch1_candidates.py.
Imported theorem-terrain language remains bounded by the documentary source and does not admit a new external claim.

renderer.version_or_environment: Python 3 standard library; deterministic SVG generator v1
reproducibility_notes: The generator uses no network, randomness, timestamps, fonts embedded as files, or external data.
Repository tests compare generator output byte-for-byte with the committed SVG candidate.

accessibility.alt_text: Status map places elementary, bounded exact, imported positive-bound, and formal structural results below a dashed line labeled open universal boundary one half.
accessibility.long_description: Four labeled boxes summarize distinct kinds of established progress: elementary families, bounded exact verification, imported positive lower bounds, and formal or structural results. A dashed line above them is labeled as the open universal one-half boundary. Text below states that no admitted result crosses that boundary and that public proof claims remain subject to independent audit.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: The visual records the programme's documentary status partition: the universal half-frequency statement remains open while the listed categories are partial or separately scoped terrain.
not_claimed: A quantitative ordering of theorem strength
A proof of the universal one-half statement

supersession_reason: Replace an island metaphor with an explicit status map separating bounded, imported, structural, and open theorem terrain.
